attributes.notes: v1 · BLOCKED on platform, not on effort — needs (1) an identity concept (same gap as "my deals"), (2) a card-reachable scheduler (the only queue is realm-server indexing/prerender), (3) a notification/email channel. All three verified absent. A block named Remind that cannot notify would mislead adopters; the record-only shape is already Activity + a future date. Also blocks Feature 1 set-reminder, Feature 3 bulk reminders, and v1.1 Smart Reminders. See spec Second Review Addendum §9
